_comment: The sample invitation the public template preview is drawn around (see src/composables/showcase-preview/useDemoShowcase.ts). Shaped exactly like one GET /api/events/:id/showcase/ response, because that is what it stands in for — `event` is the English baseline plus every language's `event_texts`, and `translations.<lang>` overlays only the fields a real backend would return translated. Every optional section the showcase can render is populated on purpose: a partner judging a template has to see what the template does to a host row, a two-day agenda, a gallery, a payment card and a dress code, not just a cover. Dates carry `{year}`; the loader rolls the calendar year forward so the countdown never runs out, and substitutes the same year into the authored date lines. Media points at /demo-showcase/*.svg (public/), resolved to absolute URLs by the loader so the showcase's getMediaUrl leaves them alone.
